seekerProtection.title: Nobody may charge people who apply
seekerProtection.body: No fee, deposit or kit charge may be asked from people who apply. Report if asked.

rule.fee_phrase: It names a charge on the applicant (registration fee, security deposit, kit or uniform charge, training fee and the like). Real employers never charge the people they hire.
rule.applicant_pays: It asks the applicant to pay or deposit money. On Vyapar, the person who posted pays; the person who works is never asked to pay.
rule.pay_before: It asks for money before joining or before the interview. That is the most common job scam.
rule.phone_payment: It asks people to send money to a phone number or through a payment app (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm).
rule.job_fee: It charges for getting a job (a placement fee, or "pay and get a job"). A service may have a price; a job may not.
